Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

Organize it around four scenarios: property loss, liability, temporary displacement, and water backup. Use the documented policy information you have, including the documented effective date, applicable coverage and deductible fields, household members, and interested-party entry. Make it clear that the worksheet is an intake aid rather than a coverage determination, and prominently instruct us to verify the latest declarations page before relying on any figures. Do not imply that the older policy information has been revalidated for 2028.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Cherrywood Renter’s-Insurance Claims-Intake Worksheet", "body": "# Cherrywood Renter’s-Insurance Claims-Intake Worksheet

> **IMPORTANT — VERIFY BEFORE RELYING ON ANY FIGURE**  
> This is an **intake aid only**, not a coverage determination, promise of payment, or substitute for the policy. The figures below come from older documented policy information. **They have not been revalidated for 2028. Before relying on any limit, deductible, or coverage description, check the latest declarations page and policy forms, then confirm details with the insurer.** Coverage depends on the actual policy terms, exclusions, conditions, cause of loss, and claim investigation.

## Documented policy reference — historical, not revalidated for 2028

- **Property:** Cherrywood rental
- **Last documented effective date:** May 1, 2027
- **Last documented renewal premium:** $318 annually
- **Personal property:** $30,000, replacement-cost coverage as documented
- **Personal-property deductible:** $500 as documented
- **Personal liability:** $300,000 as documented
- **Loss of use / additional living expense:** $10,000 as documented
- **Water backup:** $5,000 as documented
- **Interested party:** Cherrywood
- **Household people identified in records:** Riley Tanaka and Sam Okonkwo
- **Household pet identified in records:** Kibo (dog). Confirm whether the insurer lists or otherwise covers each person/pet as applicable; this worksheet does not establish insured status.

### Verify from the latest declarations page before completing or using this worksheet

- Current policy number: ______________________________
- Insurer / claims phone / online claim link: ______________________________
- Named insured(s) exactly as shown: ______________________________
- Current policy effective dates: ______________________________
- Current personal-property limit and valuation basis: ______________________________
- Deductible(s), including any separate water-backup deductible: ______________________________
- Current liability limit: ______________________________
- Current loss-of-use / additional-living-expense limit and any time limit: ______________________________
- Current water-backup limit, deductible, and endorsements: ______________________________
- Cherrywood interested-party entry exactly as shown: ______________________________
- Latest declarations checked on (date) / by: ______________________________

## First steps for any incident

- Date/time discovered: ____________________  Date/time loss began (if known): ____________________
- Cherrywood address / unit: ______________________________________________
- Person reporting / best contact: __________________________________________
- Is anyone injured or in immediate danger? ☐ No ☐ Yes — call emergency services if needed.
- Take reasonable steps to prevent further damage when safe; do not put yourself at risk. Photograph/video conditions before cleanup when feasible, keep damaged items and receipts, and record emergency repairs and communications.
- Notify the landlord/property manager promptly for building damage, unsafe conditions, needed access, or repairs. Keep the insurer and property manager informed; one notice does not replace the other.
- Insurer claim number / adjuster / date reported: ______________________________
- Cherrywood notice / work-order reference: ______________________________

## Scenario 1 — Property loss (damage, theft, or loss of household belongings)

**What happened?** ☐ Fire/smoke ☐ Theft ☐ Wind/storm ☐ Other: ____________________  
Cause/source known or suspected (label uncertainty): ____________________________________  
Room(s) / location(s): ____________________  First noticed: ____________________

**People / property affected**
- Household members involved or affected (Riley Tanaka, Sam Okonkwo, others): ____________________
- Items damaged or missing (attach inventory): item, owner, description/model, age, purchase date/cost, estimated replacement cost, serial number: ____________________________________________________________
- Any work/business-owned property or single item that may need special scheduling? ☐ No ☐ Yes/details: ____________________

**Evidence and response**
- Photos/video taken? ☐ Yes ☐ No  Receipts/inventory available? ☐ Yes ☐ No
- Police/fire report or incident number, if applicable: ____________________
- Temporary protection / emergency work, who performed it, cost, receipts: ____________________
- Other affected party / building report / witness: ____________________

**Documented reference only:** personal property $30,000; replacement-cost basis; $500 personal-property deductible. Verify current terms. A deductible or valuation method may apply differently than expected, and coverage is subject to policy terms. Current applicable deductible: __________  Current personal-property limit: __________

## Scenario 2 — Liability (someone alleges household responsibility for injury or damage)

**Do not admit fault, promise payment, or negotiate a settlement.** Preserve relevant messages and forward any demand, summons, or legal papers promptly to the insurer and seek legal advice as appropriate.

- Date/time and exact location: ____________________
- Person making the claim and safe contact details: ____________________
- What injury or property damage is alleged? State observable facts; distinguish firsthand knowledge from reports: ____________________________________________________________
- Household member involved (if known): ____________________  Witnesses: ____________________
- Photos/video, incident reports, messages, correspondence, documents: ____________________
- Medical attention / emergency response (if known): ____________________
- Any letter, demand, lawsuit, or deadline received? ☐ No ☐ Yes — date received / deadline: ____________________
- Cherrywood notified? ☐ No ☐ Yes — when / reference: ____________________
- Insurer notified? ☐ No ☐ Yes — when / claim number: ____________________

**Documented reference only:** personal liability $300,000. Verify the current limit and applicable policy provisions. Current liability limit: __________

## Scenario 3 — Temporary displacement (loss of use / additional living expenses)

Record why the home cannot reasonably be occupied and the dates; the insurer determines whether the event and expenses qualify under the policy. Coordinate habitability and access with Cherrywood.

- Incident causing displacement and related claim number: ____________________
- Date household had to leave: __________  Expected/actual return date: __________
- Who is displaced (Riley Tanaka, Sam Okonkwo, others / Kibo): ____________________
- Who determined the home was unsafe or uninhabitable, and when? ____________________
- Temporary lodging address / provider / booking dates: ____________________
- Additional expenses by date (lodging, meals, laundry, transport, pet-related costs, other): attach itemized log and receipts: ____________________________________________________________
- Normal costs avoided / reimbursements or assistance received, if requested: ____________________
- Cherrywood repair / restoration estimate and updates: ____________________
- Insurer guidance or pre-approval obtained? ☐ No ☐ Yes — details: ____________________

**Documented reference only:** loss of use $10,000. Verify current limit, covered expense categories, any time restrictions, and claim requirements before incurring or relying on reimbursement. Current limit / guidance: __________

## Scenario 4 — Water backup

Describe what was observed without assuming the source or cause. If water is near electricity, there is a risk of structural damage, or anyone is unsafe, keep clear and contact emergency services or the appropriate emergency maintenance line. Avoid contact with contaminated water; do not make unsafe repairs.

- Date/time discovered / duration if known: ____________________
- Water location and observed path / depth / spread: ____________________
- Source or suspected source (unknown is acceptable): ____________________
- Was water coming through a drain, sewer, sump, or another route? ☐ Unknown ☐ Observed/details: ____________________
- Rooms, building components, and belongings affected: ____________________
- Immediate safe steps taken; water shutoff or mitigation by whom/when: ____________________
- Photos/video before and during cleanup? ☐ Yes ☐ No
- Cleanup / drying / mitigation company, dates, invoices, moisture readings: ____________________
- Cherrywood notified; maintenance work order / response: ____________________
- Insurer notified; claim number / adjuster instructions: ____________________
- Keep samples, damaged items, invoices, and disposal records where safe and practical; note anything discarded and why: ____________________

**Documented reference only:** water-backup coverage $5,000. Verify whether the current policy includes this coverage, its definition, exclusions, deductible, sublimit, and required mitigation/documentation. Do not assume every water loss is “water backup” or covered. Current water-backup limit / deductible: __________

## Claim log and attachments

| Date/time | Person / organization | Contact or action | Reference / next step |
|---|---|---|---|
| | | | |
| | | | |
| | | | |

Attachments gathered: ☐ Latest declarations page ☐ Photos/video ☐ Item inventory ☐ Receipts ☐ Police/fire report ☐ Repair/mitigation invoices ☐ Lodging/expense log ☐ Cherrywood messages/work orders ☐ Demand/legal papers ☐ Other: ____________________

**Intake notes / unresolved questions for insurer:**
